residual.wall: Five products hide under “DAW integration.” Gasper already has a session/arrangement law and one organism clock. It has no wire.

question: What custom DAW integrations are lawful for a browser studio whose clock is VEC-401 and whose score is portable takes?
coordinateSpaces: Musical: bars.beats, MIDI clock 24 PPQN, Link quantum (usually 4 beats), MTC (SMPTE). Gasper: VEC-401 organism ms. Take: local t, relative COM. Skin: 1000-field 0..1. Do not treat 60 fps as 120 bpm.
physicalLaw: One clock writer. VEC-401 owns dispatch. An external tempo may feed it. It may not install a second ticker (GSAP, MIDI, rAF) beside it.
One physics writer. A CC that writes plant τ or contour samples is a second body.
Takes are relative. A DAW bar-1 must not snap world x to a desktop number.
artisticLaw: Session is clip launch. Arrangement is the scored take. That is the Ableton dual already in INSTRUMENT-HANDOFF.
A picker and a shelf, not a plugin face of 80 automatable knobs.
He is the instrument. Ableton is a conductor or a library, not his body.

options.name: Gasper as the DAW
options.what: Session strip launches takes. Arrangement is the existing timeline when a take is open.
options.missing: The strip itself. Empty clip slots.

options.name: OSC / WebSocket launch
options.what: /gasper/take/{id} fire, /gasper/skin/{neutral|puff|goose}, /gasper/state/{eight}. Max for Live or Bitwig Grid as the custom device.
options.have: Named takes and Skin takes. No socket.

options.name: Web MIDI clip notes
options.what: Note-on launches a shelf take. Channel 1 notes 60+ map to named clips. Browser-native.

options.name: Named-organ CC / OSC
options.what: CC 1 pressure, CC 2 coupling, CC 3 relief. Only organs that already exist on Skin.
options.risk: medium — becomes slider-dump-by-cable if gait numbers are mapped

options.name: Tempo follow
options.what: MIDI clock or Ableton Link quantum sampled by VEC-401. Transport start/stop = take play/stop.
options.missing: A follower, not a second clock. Link is UDP/native — sidecar, not in-page.
options.risk: high if a second ticker is installed

options.name: Audio-reactive listen
options.what: FFT / onset → energy or Skin pressure. Not sync. A listener.
options.missing: An analyser that does not write contour.
options.risk: medium — energy as glow already rejected once

options.name: VST3 / AU / ReWire host
options.what: Gasper as a plugin face inside Live/Logic.
options.missing: A native host. Out of this deploy.

options.name: OTIO / AAF interchange
options.what: Export arrangement as clips for an NLE/DAW. Offline.

invariants: VEC-401 remains the only dispatch clock.
512 / 360 / 672 / 1000 counts do not change because a note fired.
Firewall stays. No 1920 SVG from a CC.
Explore does not recut gait or chrome.
failureModes: MIDI clock + rAF + GSAP all advancing him (skate, the opening shake again).
CC mapped to plant τ / contour chew (cable slider dump).
Bar 1 of Live teleports world x.
Shipping a VST into this preview and calling the blank page a DAW.
Calling the Mixer a DAW because it has a timeline.
uncertainty: Whether the owner means ‘make Gasper the DAW’ or ‘talk to my Ableton.’ Those are options 1 and 2–5.
Link-in-browser quality. Most Link stacks are native UDP.
tests: No second requestAnimationFrame loop is added for tempo.
A launch message only calls playAuthoredTake / applySkinTake.
Unplugging MIDI does not freeze VEC-401.
visualConsequences: Session strip reads as a clip grid. Not a preference pane.
When Live launches Goose, the pearl pebbles. When it launches Neutral, rest.
Clock follow makes Walk sit on the kick. It must not make the camera nod.
implementation: Do not install Link inside the painter.
First lawful wire, if Work is approved: OSC + Web MIDI launch of named takes and Skin takes. One map page.
Clock follow is second. Follower into VEC-401 only.
Session strip is the in-app DAW. That is already the handoff. It is not this Explore’s cut unless asked.

citations.rule: Ableton dual is already the instrument law. Clip grid to play; timeline to score.
Consumers never install, start, pause, seed, or retime the clock.
